description: This file is a post-installation script for managing bundled plugins within a software project. It handles discovering runtime dependencies, checking the environment, and installing missing dependencies via npm, specifically tailored for a plugin-based architecture.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the given file path and parses its content.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's package.json within node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Scans the extensions directory to discover runtime dependencies of bundled plugins.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a clean environment object for npm install, removing certain global configs.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Determines if the current package root is a source checkout by checking for specific files/directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Decides whether to execute the postinstall based on environment and directory state.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function to run the postinstall process, installing missing runtime dependencies.
